results.title: Rapid multi-site rollout with no stated unified monitoring platform
results.closest_fact_claim: Beyond Hyderabad, Snowman is expanding in Pune (adding a 5,900-pallet facility by June 2026 on top of an existing 16,000-pallet site) and has projects underway in Kolkata, Krishnapatnam, and Patna.

results.title: Pharma cold-chain compliance load without confirmed automated audit reporting
results.closest_fact_claim: Snowman serves pharmaceuticals, quick-service restaurants (QSR), seafood, and e-commerce clients, and offers value-added services like blast freezing, kitting, labeling, sorting, and repacking.

results.title: 600+ vehicle reefer fleet without a stated real-time asset-tracking layer
results.closest_fact_claim: Snowman operates a fleet of 600+ trucks, including primary and secondary refrigerated (reefer) vehicles, to keep the cold chain unbroken during transport.
